info.title: TABSIRA API
info.description: Photo to insight, backed by one Quran verse and one hadith.

get.summary: Liveness
get.description:
Report that the process is up and serving.

Touches no dependency, so it stays cheap enough for a per-second probe and
answers even when the database is down.

get.summary: Readiness
get.description:
Report whether this process can serve a request, which needs the database.

The check is bounded by the connect timeout, so a database that is down or
hangs answers 503 `degraded` quickly instead of holding the request.

get.summary: The features that are switched on
get.description: Name the features that are on, parents applied; a feature not listed answers 404.

post.summary: Create an account with an e-mail address and a password
post.description:
Create the account, sign it in, and mail a verification link.

The new account can be used at once; its address stays unverified until the
link is followed. Rate limited per IP and per e-mail address. A mail that
cannot be sent never fails the sign-up.

post.summary: Sign in with an e-mail address and a password
post.description:
Start a session.

A wrong address and a wrong password answer the same 401. Rate limited per IP
and per e-mail address, counting failed attempts, before the password is checked.

post.summary: End the current session
post.description: End the session and clear the cookie. Safe to repeat, and to call with no session.

get.summary: The signed-in account
get.description: Return the caller's own account. The private profile fields are not part of it.

post.summary: Accept the current terms of use and privacy policy
post.description:
Record that the signed-in account accepts both texts, for a version that changed.

The versions must be the current ones (`GET /legal`); anything else is a 422
`legal_acceptance_required`. Two consent rows are appended; none is ever edited. It also
takes, for a Google account, the real full name (`display_name`, only while the acceptance
is pending or the name is empty; an account with no name must give one: 422) and the answer
to the `public_full_name` consent (decision 64).

get.summary: Which ways of signing in are available
get.description: Whether password and Google sign-in can be used, for the sign-in page to show.

post.summary: Confirm an e-mail address with the mailed link's token
post.description:
Mark the address verified. The token works once; any bad token answers the same 400.

The caller needs no session: whoever holds the token read the mail.

post.summary: Mail the verification link again
post.description:
Answer 202 whether or not the address has an unverified account.

Rate limited per IP and per address. A new link cancels the earlier one.

post.summary: Mail a password reset link
post.description:
Answer 202 whether or not the address has an account.

Rate limited per IP and per address. A new link cancels the earlier one. The
mail is sent after the answer, so the time it takes says nothing either.

post.summary: Choose a new password with the mailed link's token
post.description:
Set the new password and end every other session of the account.

The token works once. Following it also proves the address, so it is marked
verified. The caller is not signed in by it: they sign in with the new password.

get.summary: Send the browser to Google to sign in
get.description:
Begin the authorization code flow with PKCE (S256), a state and a nonce.

Redirects to Google. The state, the code verifier and the nonce are kept on
the server for GOOGLE_STATE_TTL_SECONDS; a cookie ties them to this browser.

parameters.name: next

schema.description: A path in the web app to return to; anything else is ignored.
schema.title: Next

parameters.description: A path in the web app to return to; anything else is ignored.

get.summary: Where Google sends the browser back
get.description:
Finish the sign-in: check the state, exchange the code, validate the ID token.

Then link or create the account, start a session and redirect to the web app.

get.summary: The caller's profile
get.description:
Return the caller's own profile, empty answers as `unknown`.

The religious background, the gender and the age range are private: this
route and the account export are the only places they are ever returned.

patch.summary: Change some answers of the caller's profile
patch.description:
Change the fields sent and no others.

Enums are validated; a null is refused (send `unknown` to clear an answer).
The three consent switches change through `POST /consents` only; declaring under 13
withdraws the photo consent and deletes the kept photos (503 when the store is down).

post.summary: Record an answer to a consent question
post.description:
Append the answer to the user's consent history, and update the matching switch.

A consent is withdrawn by recording the same kind with `granted` false. The
history is never edited. Withdrawing the photo consent deletes the kept photos
first; 503 STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE, with nothing recorded, when the store is down.

Withdrawing needs no acceptance of the current texts, as taking an insight off public view
does not; giving a consent does (403 `legal_acceptance_required`).

get.summary: Download everything the account owns
get.description: Return the account, its profile, consents, identities, sessions and learning as JSON.

delete.summary: Delete the account and everything it owns
delete.description:
Delete the user, their profile, consents, identities, sessions, photos and everything they saved.

Idempotent: without a valid session there is nothing left to delete, and the
answer is the same 204 that clears the cookie. 503 STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE, with nothing
deleted, when the photo store cannot be reached.

get.summary: Search places by Arabic or Latin name
get.description:
Return places whose name matches `q`, in Arabic or in Latin letters.

Exact matches come first, then names that start with `q`, each by
population, then similar names. `label` is the Arabic name when there is
one. The text is matched without regard to case, accents, Arabic vowel
marks or the alef, ta marbuta and ya variants.

get.summary: The populated place nearest to a point
get.description:
Return the nearest populated place within `radius_m`, with its region and country.

It labels an approximate location: send the rounded point (see
`src/geo/privacy.py`), never the exact one of a photo, and keep the answer
to the place found. Nothing is returned when no populated place is in range.

get.summary: Countries
get.description: Return every country, with its Arabic name when GeoNames has one.

get.summary: One verse of the Quran
get.description: Return a verse of quranpedia's mushaf 2 exactly as stored, with its hash and source.

get.summary: One hadith
get.description: Return a hadith exactly as stored, with its spans, its ruling and its eligibility.

post.summary: Report errors a page saw
post.description:
Accept a page's error reports and forward them to GlitchTip, cleaned.

Answers 204 whether or not anything is forwarded.

get.summary: The categories to choose between and the re-ask interval
get.description:
Return the current policy.

The policy is its version, each category with its Arabic title and description, and the
number of days after which a choice lapses and the visitor is asked again.

post.summary: Record a cookie choice
post.description:
Append the choice and return the consent id with what is in force.

The first call has no `consent_id`; keep the one returned in a first-party cookie and send
it with every later choice, so they are one history. Choosing again is a new record, never
an edit. The user agent is reduced to its browser family and no address is kept.

get.summary: The choice in force for a consent id
get.description:
Return what the id's latest choice allows now.

While the choice is current its categories are the ones chosen; once the policy changed or
the re-ask interval passed, `reask` is true and only the necessary category is on. An id the
server never issued is a 404.

get.summary: Every section's pages
get.description:
List the sections that are advertised, each with its pages and their last change.

A section whose feature is switched off is not listed, and a section with nothing to list
has no pages.

get.summary: One page of a section
get.description:
List one page of a section, in a stable order.

A page past the last is empty. A section whose feature is off is a 404, like its pages.

schema.title: Response Sitemap Section Sitemap  Section  Get

get.summary: The caller's handle and the name shown beside it
get.description: Return the handle the caller appears under (null until they choose one) and the name shown.

put.description:
Set the handle (`/u/<handle>`) every public page shows for the caller.

Needs a verified e-mail address. The handle is unique whatever its case: 409
`HANDLE_TAKEN` when somebody else holds it. The full name shows beside it only while the
`public_full_name` consent is given (`POST /consents`); `public_name` in the body is ignored.

get.summary: A public profile
get.description:
Return a member's public profile: handle, name (with consent), month joined and three counts.

404 for a handle nobody holds, and for one that a block stands in front of, in either
direction. Nothing from the member's private profile, and no e-mail address, ever.

put.description: Follow a member; following again changes nothing. 400 for oneself.

delete.description: Stop following a member; safe to repeat.

get.summary: The members the caller has blocked
get.description: List the members the caller blocked, newest first, by handle, and name only with consent.

put.description:
Block a member.

Each of the two stops seeing the other everywhere, and the follows between them, in
both directions, end. Blocking again changes nothing. 400 for oneself. A handle nobody
holds answers 204 like any other: a 404 here would tell the caller that a handle they can
no longer see (`/u/{handle}` says 404 for a block too) does exist and has blocked them.

delete.description: Lift the caller's own block; safe to repeat, and 204 for a handle nobody holds too.

post.summary: Start a draft from a verified insight
post.description:
Copy one of the caller's verified insights into a publication and open a draft on it.

The copy is what is previewed and what is published; it is never edited afterwards. The
caller's own words go in `reflection`, apart from the insight. 409 `INSIGHT_NOT_PUBLISHABLE`
says why an insight cannot be published; 409 `PUBLIC_IDENTITY_REQUIRED` that the caller
has no handle yet. Nothing is visible to anyone else until the draft is submitted.

get.summary: One post
get.description:
Return a post the caller may read.

404 for one that does not exist or that the caller may not see (a draft, a post held or
refused, one for followers the caller does not follow, one behind a block); 410 Gone for
one that was withdrawn or removed.

patch.description: Change a draft's reflection or audience; a refused post becomes a draft again.

delete.description:
Withdraw a post, a draft or a published one.

Its reflection, its comments, its likes and its saves are erased at once, with the public
copy of its photo, it leaves every feed and every profile, and its address answers 410 Gone
from then on (this route too).

post.summary: Submit a draft for publication
post.description:
Run a draft through the guard.

The answer says what happened: `published`, `rejected` with its reason, or
`pending_review` while a moderator looks. A failed guard holds the post, never
publishes it. 409 for a post that is not a draft.

get.summary: The caller's own posts, in every state
get.description:
List the caller's posts, newest first, with what happened to each.

Withdrawn posts are gone and are not listed; one a moderator removed is, with its reason.

put.summary: React to a post: «انتفعتُ بها» or «جزاك الله خيرًا»
put.description: React to a published post the caller may read; reacting again changes nothing.

delete.description: Take back the caller's reaction of this kind; safe to repeat.

put.description: Save a published post the caller may read; saving again changes nothing.

delete.description: Unsave a post; safe to repeat. A post that is gone is already gone from the list.

get.summary: The posts the caller saved
get.description:
List what the caller saved, the latest save first, and only what they may still read.

A post that was withdrawn, removed or hidden by a block is no longer listed.

get.summary: A post's comments
get.description:
List a post's comments oldest first, each with its replies.

Only published comments, and the caller's own in any state. A comment by someone the caller
blocked, or who blocked the caller, or whom the post's author blocked, is not listed.

post.summary: Comment on a post, or reply to a comment
post.description:
Add a comment, or a reply (`parent_id`) to a comment that is not itself a reply.

The answer says what the guard decided: `published`, `rejected` with its reason, or
`pending_review` while a moderator looks; until it is published only its author sees it.

delete.description:
Delete one's own comment, whatever its state and whatever the caller can still read.

Its replies go with it. Someone else's comment is a 404, as is one that does not exist.

post.summary: Report a post, a comment, a map entry or a sponsor's reflection
post.description:
Tell the moderators about something the caller may read.

The reasons include a false attribution of a religious claim, a photo published without
permission, a place that is not right and a location or photo that gives away private
information. 404 for what the caller may not read, and for a target whose feature is switched
off, 400 for their own words. Reporting the same thing twice answers with the first report. Enough different reporters send a published
item back to the moderation queue (`SOCIAL_REPORT_HOLD_THRESHOLD`), and the public copy of a
photo it showed is deleted until a moderator approves it.

get.summary: «أتابع»: the posts of the members the caller follows
get.description:
Return the posts of the members the caller follows, newest first.

Followers-only posts of those members are included. `empty_reason` is `follows_nobody` when
the caller follows no one and `no_posts` when those they follow have published nothing.

get.summary: «لك»: a ranked feed with the reason for each post
get.description:
Return the newest readable posts, ranked, each with `why` («لماذا أرى هذا؟»).

The ranking uses freshness, the members the caller follows, variety of topics and what the
caller has already liked, saved or commented on. It never uses religion or any personal
detail, and the caller can switch personalisation off, which leaves freshness and variety.
The first request pins the moment of ranking in `next_cursor`, so the next pages continue the
same list.

get.summary: Every public post, newest first
get.description: Return the public posts in the order they were published; no ranking, no personalisation.

get.summary: A member's published posts
get.description:
Return a member's published posts that the caller may read, newest first.

404 when no such member exists or a block stands between the two.

get.summary: Current legal versions and contact addresses
get.description: Return the versions a sign-up must accept, and the addresses the legal pages name.

post.summary: Send a message to support
post.description:
Email the message to the support address, replies going to the visitor.

A filled `website` field is a bot: it gets the same 202 and nothing is sent. The account
id is added to the mail when a valid session cookie is present. Answers 503
`mail_unavailable` when mail is not configured or the send fails. The attempt is counted
(keyed hashes in PostgreSQL, shared by every worker) before the mail is sent.

post.summary: Start a scan of a photo or of a photo's address
post.description:
Check the photo, keep it for an hour, queue the scan and answer at once.

403 `account_required` for a guest that holds its one scan, 403 `profile_required` for an
account that has not completed its profile (decision 64), both before the photo is read.

get.summary: A scan and what it found
get.description: Return the owner's scan: its state, its scene and its insights.

get.summary: The stripped photo of a scan, while it is kept
get.description: Return the photo without its metadata to its owner, for the hour it is kept.

get.summary: The progress of a scan, as server-sent events
get.description:
Stream `queued`, `stage`, then `done` or `failed` for the scan's current run.

A reader that reconnects sends `Last-Event-ID` and gets only what it missed.

post.summary: Point at one thing in the scene and look again
post.description: Run the engine again on the thing the learner chose or the box they drew.

post.summary: Answer the one question the scan asked
post.description: Run the engine again with the learner's answer.

get.summary: One insight, its scripture read from the store
get.description: Return the insight: its verse and hadith exactly as stored, the explanation apart.

post.summary: Ask one question about the insight (three at most)
post.description:
Answer a question classified by its content level, grounded in the insight.

The same `idempotencyKey` returns the same answer and counts once; the
fourth successful message answers 409 CHAT_LIMIT_REACHED. A request for
another text runs the retrieval and the verification again (v2 §14). 403
`profile_required` for an account that has not completed its profile (decision 64).

post.summary: Declare the small step done, or for later
post.description: Record «نفّذته» or «سأفعله لاحقًا»: the learner's own statement, never a proof or a reward.

post.summary: «تمّ»: complete the insight, once
post.description:
Complete the insight; a second call saves nothing more and answers the same place.

The first «تمّ» of a signed-in owner who consented to keep photos also keeps the scan's
photo privately (v2 §19); nothing is kept for a guest or a sensitive scene.

put.description:
Publish the caller's own insight; asking again changes nothing.

Answers 409 INSIGHT_NOT_PUBLISHABLE for a sensitive scene, an insight with no text to
show from the store, text that looks like scripture, one shaped by the profile, or one that is not from the real
analysis; 409 UNDER_13_CANNOT_PUBLISH when the account declared it is under 13 (v2 §5).
A guest gets 401.

delete.summary: Withdraw the insight from public view
delete.description:
Take the caller's insight down at once; its public address answers 404 from then on.

Withdrawing publishes nothing, so it needs neither a verified address nor the latest
terms, and it is never switched off or rate limited.

get.summary: One published insight, its scripture read from the store
get.description: Return the published insight: verse and hadith as stored, the author only if chosen.

get.summary: The map: regions under fog, the places that came out of it, threads
get.description:
Return every region with its fog, the caller's places, threads and ready treasures.

A newcomer gets the whole map under fog: there is nothing to hide and nothing to make.
A concept learned without a reveal yet (before reveals existed, or with the world
off) gets one here first, shown without its effect.

post.summary: Record that the world played these reveals
post.description:
Mark the caller's reveals as shown, so their effect never plays again; asking again changes nothing.

Ids of another owner's reveals, or of none, are ignored, never reported.

post.summary: Open a place: a return can show its treasure
post.description: Record the visit and return the place with its insights and a treasure that is ready.

post.summary: Reveal a treasure that is ready
post.description: Return the treasure's verified text from the store; 409 TREASURE_NOT_READY before the return.

get.summary: Practice, never piety: ranks, streak, quest, sky, badges
get.description:
Return what the learner's recorded practice adds up to, with the practice disclaimer.

Counted from looks, completions, declared steps, places, treasures and
questions only; never faith, never reward, never a comparison with anyone.

parameters.name: tz

schema.description: The learner's IANA time zone, for what «today» means; UTC by default
schema.title: Tz

parameters.description: The learner's IANA time zone, for what «today» means; UTC by default

put.summary: Place one of the caller's insights on the atlas, as a draft
put.description:
Keep the exact point privately and answer with what the map will show.

The public point is the centre of the grid cell (GEO_APPROX_CELL_METERS), labelled with
the nearest populated place; the answer carries the cell as a polygon, so the owner reviews
it before publishing. 409 INSIGHT_NOT_PUBLISHABLE for an insight that is not the pipeline's.
Placing a published entry again takes it off the map, and its photo's public copy with it.

get.summary: The caller's own entry for an insight
get.description: Return the entry with its private point and its public preview; 404 when there is none.

delete.summary: Withdraw the entry from the atlas
delete.description: Take the entry off the map and forget its exact point; its address answers 410 from then on.

post.summary: Show the entry on the atlas
post.description: Publish a placed draft; 409 for an entry that is not a draft.

get.summary: The caller's entries, in every state

schema.title: Response My Entries Me Map Entries Get

get.summary: The published entries inside a map window
get.description:
Return a GeoJSON FeatureCollection of the published entries in the window, newest first.

Every geometry is a public point: the centre of an approximation cell, never where a photo
was taken, and `published_on` is a day, never a time. A window with `west > east` crosses
the antimeridian. `truncated` says more entries lie in the window than `limit` allowed; ask
for a smaller window. For a signed-in viewer, entries of members a block stands between
are left out.

get.summary: One published entry
get.description:
Return the entry's page: the insight with its scripture from the store, the public point and its place.

410 once withdrawn, and for the id an entry had before its place was widened.

get.summary: A place and the entries labelled with it
get.description: «ذاكرة المكان»: the place from GeoNames and its published entries, newest first; 404 without any.

get.summary: Orphaned entries near a point, at their widened place
get.description:
Entries nobody looks after near the position, newest first.

Near means the entry's public point is within `radius` metres, or the position lies inside the
city, region or country the place was widened to. Each is shown at the place it was widened
to, with no author's name. The position is snapped to a grid of about 0.05 degrees before
anything is asked, used for this request and kept nowhere; the answer is never cached. A block
changes nothing here: the author is anonymous.

put.description:
Look after an orphaned entry: it returns to the atlas at its widened place, under the caller's handle.

404 for an entry the caller cannot see (a block against its sponsor; a block against its
anonymous author changes nothing), 409 for their own entry, one that has a sponsor or one that
is not orphaned, and
`UNDER_13_CANNOT_PUBLISH` for an account that declared it is under 13. One sponsor at a time.

delete.description: Stop looking after the entry; the reflection goes with it and the entry stays on the atlas for now.

put.summary: Write or replace the sponsor's reflection
put.description:
Put the sponsor's own words under the entry; the guard judges them as it judges a comment.

The answer says what it decided: `published`, `rejected` with its reason, or `pending_review`
while a person looks, and until it is published only its sponsor sees it. 422 for words that
read like Quran or hadith, 404 without an open sponsorship of the caller's.

get.summary: The caller's sponsorships, with the state of their reflections

schema.title: Response My Sponsorships Me Sponsorships Get

get.summary: A photo's public copy (local disk only)
get.description: Return the published copy under `public/<name>`; 404 when the store is S3 or there is none.

get.summary: The prepared rain scene and its two insights
get.description:
Return the rain scene with «الحياة في قطرة» and «الغرس الذي يتعدّاك».

The verses come from the store; each hadith shows once an editor has
recorded its dorar.net ruling, or before it when it counts as one of the
enriched Sunnah file's (decision 58), and otherwise the insight says it waits.

post.summary: Keep a copy of a tutorial insight, to complete it and ask about it
post.description: Return the caller's copy of the insight (made once), labelled «مثال موثّق مُعدّ».

get.summary: The sound effect of one ontology entity, as MP3
get.description: Return `static/ontology/audio/<entity_id>.mp3` of the bucket; 404 when it was not uploaded.

parameters.name: entity_id

schema.description: An ontology id such as E001
schema.title: Entity Id

parameters.description: An ontology id such as E001

AccountExport.title: AccountExport
AccountExport.description:
Everything the account owns so far, for its owner.

A table that gets a user id later must be added here and to the deletion in
`account_service`; a test fails when a table references `users` without a cascade.

ActionOut.title: ActionOut
ActionOut.description: What the learner declared about the small step: a statement, never a proof or a reward.

ActionState.title: ActionState
ActionState.description: What the learner declared about the small step: a statement, never a proof (tajriba §9).

AdminArea.title: AdminArea
AdminArea.description: The first-level administrative division (region, governorate, state) of a place.

explanation.title: Explanation
explanation.description: The app's explanation, shortened; written by the app

author.description: Null once the entry was orphaned, and for good after it: no handle beside a widened place

orphaned.title: Orphaned
orphaned.description: Nobody looks after it: any verified member may sponsor it

sponsor.description: Who looks after it; the sponsor chose to be named

sponsor_reflection.title: Sponsor Reflection
sponsor_reflection.description: The sponsor's own words, once published; never scripture, never the author's

sponsor_reflection_id.title: Sponsor Reflection Id
sponsor_reflection_id.description: The id to report the reflection by (`target_type` sponsorship); null without one

post_id.title: Post Id
post_id.description: The public post of the same insight, if one is published

photo_url.title: Photo Url
photo_url.description: The address of the photo's public copy, only when the owner chose to show it with the entry and the copy exists; null otherwise. Never a storage key.

AtlasEntryOut.title: AtlasEntryOut
AtlasEntryOut.description: A published entry on its own page: the insight by reference, the public point, its place.

AtlasFeature.title: AtlasFeature
AtlasFeature.description: One published entry as a GeoJSON Feature; `geometry` is the public point.

truncated.title: Truncated
truncated.description: More entries lie in the window than were returned

author.description: Null once the entry was orphaned: a widened place carries no author's name

published_on.title: Published On
published_on.description: The day, never the time: no trail of a person's hours

orphaned.title: Orphaned
orphaned.description: Nobody looks after it: it can be sponsored (decision 60)

sponsor.description: Who looks after it; chosen in public by the sponsor

AtlasFeatureProperties.title: AtlasFeatureProperties
AtlasFeatureProperties.description: No insight id here: a public id is a timestamp, and the scan time is nobody's business.

AtlasOrphansOut.title: AtlasOrphansOut
AtlasOrphansOut.description: Orphaned entries near a point, each at its widened place, newest first.

AtlasPlaceOut.title: AtlasPlaceOut
AtlasPlaceOut.description: A place page: the place, its point from GeoNames, and the entries labelled with it.

BBox.title: BBox
BBox.description: A box as ratios of the image; `x` and `y` are its top-left corner.

photo.title: Photo
photo.description: Show the insight's kept photo with the entry; nothing without a kept photo and the owner's photo consent (v2 §19)

CapturePointIn.title: CapturePointIn
CapturePointIn.description: Where the photo was taken, or the public place the owner chose; private to the owner.

CapturePointOut.title: CapturePointOut
CapturePointOut.description: The owner's own point, echoed to the owner alone.

quran.description: The verse the answer found after a new search, as stored

hadith.description: The hadith the answer found after a new search, as stored

closed.title: Closed
closed.description: «تمّ» closed the insight: its messages stay, no new question

ClarifyIn.title: ClarifyIn
ClarifyIn.description: The learner's answer to the one question the scan asked.

ClientBreadcrumb.title: ClientBreadcrumb
ClientBreadcrumb.description: One thing that happened before the error, as the page remembers it.

ClientReport.title: ClientReport
ClientReport.description: One error or log record from the browser.

ClientReportBatch.title: ClientReportBatch
ClientReportBatch.description: A page's pending reports, flushed together.

first_time.title: First Time
first_time.description: False when «تمّ» was already recorded: nothing was saved twice

reveal.description: The reveal of the insight's concept; null with the world off, or when its region had no room left

treasure_prepared.title: Treasure Prepared
treasure_prepared.description: A hidden treasure waits; it shows on return

suggest_account.title: Suggest Account
suggest_account.description: Set for a guest after the first completion

landmark.title: Landmark
landmark.description: The region's landmark: the first concept learned there

created.title: Created
created.description: Made by this completion; false when the concept was learned before

CompletionRevealOut.title: CompletionRevealOut
CompletionRevealOut.description: What the completion lifted from the clouds of the world picture (decision 59).

ConsentCategories.title: ConsentCategories
ConsentCategories.description: Each category and whether it is on. The necessary one always is.

ConsentPolicyOut.title: ConsentPolicyOut
ConsentPolicyOut.description: What a visitor is asked, and when they are asked again.

CookieConsentExport.title: CookieConsentExport
CookieConsentExport.description: One recorded choice, as the account export shows it.

CookieConsentIn.title: CookieConsentIn
CookieConsentIn.description:
A choice, as the visitor made it.

`consent_id` is the id the server gave this browser before; leave it out on the first
choice. An id the server does not know is not adopted: a new one is made and returned.
`policy_version` is the version of the text the visitor was shown; leave it out for the
current one. The two flags must be JSON booleans.

ProfilePatch.title: ProfilePatch
ProfilePatch.description:
The fields a user may change, any of them, alone.

The three consent switches are not here: they change only through
`POST /consents`, which records the answer. A field sent as null is refused;
to clear an answer, send `unknown` (or `[]` for the goals).

Skipping the optional questions is `questions_asked: true` alone: every
field stays `unknown` and the questions are never offered again. Answering
any of the three question fields records the same.

`complete_profile: true` completes the profile (decision 64) and needs an explicit answer
to every question in the same body: `goals` (`[]` is «أفضّل عدم الإجابة»),
`knowledge_level`, `age_range`, `religious_background` and `gender` (`unknown` is that
answer). A body that leaves one out is a 422.

A published insight for any reader: scripture from the store, nothing of the owner's.

There is no photo, no scan, no location, no chat, no progress, no «لماذا ظهر هذا؟» (its

«ما ظهر» part (it describes the photo); the author is
